description.zh: 我更偏爱那些表层像被认真设计过、底层又能被继续组合的产品。从 NFX compose 布局到 React 路由边界，模块替换成本决定架构是否诚实。
description.en: I prefer products that feel authored on the surface and composable underneath. From NFX compose layouts to React route boundaries, swap cost tells you if the architecture is honest.
description.fr: Je préfère les produits travaillés en surface et composables en profondeur — le coût de remplacement des modules révèle l'honnêteté de l'architecture.

description.zh: 动画应该服务于阅读顺序、空间连续性与触感清晰，而不是炫耀自己。Pinned rail、diagonal drift、纸飞机 MotionPath 都是同一套 choreographic grammar。
description.en: Animation should support reading order, continuity, and tactile clarity — not show off. Pinned rails, diagonal drift, and voyager MotionPath share one choreographic grammar.
description.fr: L'animation sert l'ordre de lecture et la continuité — rails épinglés, dérive diagonale et voyager partagent une grammaire chorégraphique.

description.zh: 可以在界面评审、Verilog 时序报告、Kafka topic 命名与产品逻辑之间自然切换。CpE 背景不是分散注意力，是切换倍率。
description.en: Comfortable moving between UI review, Verilog timing reports, Kafka topic naming, and product logic. CpE background is a gear multiplier, not distraction.
description.fr: À l'aise entre revue UI, timing Verilog, nommage Kafka et logique produit — le génie informatique comme multiplicateur.

description.zh: Go Fiber + gRPC + Kafka 流水线、FastAPI 领域模块、以及 CQRS 仓储模式——关注失败模式、重试语义与 poison topic，而不只是 happy path CRUD。
description.en: Go Fiber + gRPC + Kafka pipelines, FastAPI domain modules, CQRS repos — focus on failure modes, retry semantics, poison topics, not just happy-path CRUD.
description.fr: Pipelines Go/Kafka, modules FastAPI, CQRS — modes d'échec, retries, poison topics, pas seulement CRUD nominal.

description.zh: Traefik HTTPS、Compose 模块化、证书自动化与备份策略——在 homelab 环境练习 prod 心态：postmortem、runbook、staging diff。
description.en: Traefik HTTPS, modular Compose, cert automation, backup strategy — homelab as prod mindset training: postmortems, runbooks, staging diffs.
description.fr: Traefik, Compose modulaire, certs auto, sauvegardes — homelab comme entraînement prod : postmortems et runbooks.

description.zh: NFX-Vault 与 NFX-Identity 把 ACME、PEM 校验、bcrypt、RBAC 列表当作默认选项而非附加功能。Frontend 也不存储 long-lived secrets。
description.en: NFX-Vault and NFX-Identity treat ACME, PEM validation, bcrypt, RBAC lists as defaults — not add-ons. Frontend never stores long-lived secrets.
description.fr: Vault et Identity : ACME, PEM, bcrypt, RBAC par défaut ; pas de secrets longue durée côté client.

description.zh: ScrollTrigger invalidateOnRefresh、React Query staleTime 竞态、FPGA timing slack——不同层级的「慢」有不同探针。Profiler 红条之前，先问用户觉得哪里重。
description.en: ScrollTrigger invalidateOnRefresh, React Query staleTime races, FPGA timing slack — different layers of "slow" need different probes. Ask where it feels heavy before the profiler turns red.
description.fr: invalidateOnRefresh, staleTime, timing slack — sonder où ça « pèse » avant le profiler.

description.zh: makeUnifiedQuery 模式、camelCase 自动转换、CSS Modules 与 GSAP scope——类型与约定减少 scroll 动画页面上的 regression 面积。
description.en: makeUnifiedQuery pattern, camelCase transforms, CSS Modules + GSAP scope — types and conventions shrink regression surface on scroll-heavy pages.
description.fr: makeUnifiedQuery, camelCase, CSS Modules + GSAP — types et conventions réduisent les régressions.

description.zh: Mock JSON 字段与 errors/langs 生成流程保持一致——早期 stress i18n 避免上线后补翻译债务。Footer 星球 label 也走同一套 key。
description.en: Mock JSON fields align with errors/langs generation — stress i18n early to avoid translation debt. Footer planet labels use the same key pattern.
description.fr: JSON mock aligné avec errors/langs — stress i18n tôt ; labels planètes footer même schéma.

description.zh: 六份 FPGA lab、能量回收烘干机 capstone、嵌入式 I²C 调试——寄存器思维帮助写更 predictable 的软件 state machine。
description.en: Six FPGA labs, energy-recovery dryer capstone, embedded I²C debug — register thinking makes software state machines more predictable.
description.fr: Six labs FPGA, capstone sécheuse, I²C embarqué — pensée registre pour state machines logicielles prévisibles.

description.zh: NFX-News FastMCP 包把 crawl、analytics、search 暴露给 AI client——ops 与模型读同一 Kafka 事件流，而不是平行 silo。
description.en: NFX-News FastMCP packs expose crawl, analytics, search to AI clients — ops and models read the same Kafka stream, not parallel silos.
description.fr: FastMCP NFX-News : crawl, analytics, search pour clients IA sur le même flux Kafka.

description.zh: NFX Documentation Hub 与每次 incident postmortem 同级重要——没有 runbook 的 compose stack 只是个人记忆，不可交接。
description.en: NFX Documentation Hub ranks with incident postmortems — compose stacks without runbooks are personal memory, not handoff-ready systems.
description.fr: Hub doc = postmortems ; stack sans runbook = mémoire personnelle, pas système transmissible.
